Frequently Asked Question's

  • Can the platform handle multi-country payroll and currencies?

    Yes—country taxes, social security, statutory exports, multi-currency payslips, and bank files.

  • Do you integrate with biometric devices and remote clock-ins?

    Yes—popular fingerprint/face devices, web/remote clock-ins, CSV/Excel imports.

  • Which standards do you cover and how do projects run?

    ISO 9001, 45001, 22000, 14001, 21001, 39001; gap → SOPs → training → IAs → audit-day support.

  • Do you help with surveillance audits and corrective actions?

    Yes—evidence packs, CARs, and surveillance readiness checklists.

  • What formats are available and who designs curricula?

    On-site, live virtual, and outdoor; curricula co-designed by function, level, and industry.

  • How do you measure impact after a workshop/offsite?

    Pre/post scores, manager feedback, adoption tasks, and KPI follow-ups.

  • Can you align us to ISO 18788 and improve incident reporting?

    Yes—SOPs, logs, radio protocol, incident templates, and drills.

  • Do you support mass-event operations and site audits?

    Yes—guard posts, crowd control, ticketing, and surprise audits with reports.

  • How fast can we go live?

    Typical go-live is 3-6 weeks; larger multi-country or multi-site rollouts may phase by region.

  • Do you provide ongoing support and quarterly reviews?

    Yes—quarterly improvement cycles across HRMS, ISO, training, and security.
